title: Unit Event — Cast a Spell on You — Episode6 Just Like Magic

meta.Event Outline: Having held their real-life event, Shizuku and the others feel that their bond with their fans has grown even stronger. While exploring ideas with their fans, one of them suggests making MORE MORE JUMP! stage outfits as their next endeavor!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do I want to convey with my outfit...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Despite there being so many idol outfits, putting one on always feels like a transformation process.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Like I'm turning into a different me...
Someone who sparkles and is capable of doing anything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Someone who sparkles and is capable of doing anything... Hehe. I think I understand what she meant by that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I remember when...

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
Shizuku, you were late on that turn...!

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Now you're going too early!
Stay in sync with everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Good work, everyone.
We're finally moving as a unit.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: Our first show is next week, so let's perfect this until then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I keep getting stuck there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't have any time left until our show...! I need to learn how to do this dance as soon as I can!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't want to be the one that holds everyone back...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, what are you doing up so late...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Maintain your focus through the last turn and... Stop!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I did it... Not a single mistake...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, I should go through it once more before I forget what I just did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We get to try on our stage outfits today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not long after this, we'll be doing our show...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I think I'm just a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Select Member A
rows.Line: I don't blame you. After all, this is gonna be your first show since joining Cheerful * Days. There's gonna be a lot more people compared to when you were still in training...

rows.Speaker: Select Member B
rows.Line:
But you'll be fine.
You've been working so hard every day.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Here are your stage outfits, everyone.
They've each been tailor-made, so be sure you find the one that's actually yours.

rows.Speaker: Select Member B
rows.Line:
Wow, these are so cute!
With a nice hint of sophistication too!

rows.Speaker: Select Member C
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to put mine on!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I really get to dance on stage while wearing this...?)

rows.Speaker: Select Member A
rows.Line: Hey, let's try ours on too!

rows.Speaker: Select Member A
rows.Line: It looks amazing on you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Select Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, you look gorgeous!
It might be your first show, but you're probably gonna be the most like an idol out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right. I'm not just Shizuku Hinomori anymore. I'm Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm an idol now. I have to learn to spread and inspire hope in our fans.)
The day of her first show

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(This is it...
No mistakes. Our fans won't have any of it...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I practiced as much as I could. I know each song and dance routine now. Airi even said she'd be coming, so I need to help make this show a success...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'll be okay. I'm an idol now!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
My name is Shizuku Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to sing and dance with everything I have today, so we hope you enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This is incredible. I feel so light on my feet...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's like I can dance through all the parts that have been giving me so much trouble with little effort....!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Almost like someone cast a spell on me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(So much cheering...!
I've never heard these kinds of roars before...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(They're really here to see me perform.
Shizuku Hinomori the idol...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I don't want to disappoint them.
I want to learn how to spread hope to all of them...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't honestly say if I'll be able to accomplish such a feat...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I have a feeling I can as long as I'm donning this outfit. Because I'm Shizuku Hinomori the idol...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to do everything I can to put smiles on all their faces...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
This show's just getting started, so please enjoy what we have in store for you!
